arguments.name: engineName
arguments.description: (Required) Specifies the name of the engine that this option group should be associated with.

arguments.name: majorEngineVersion
arguments.description: (Required) Specifies the major version of the engine that this option group should be associated with.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: (Optional, Forces new resource) Name of the option group. If omitted, Terraform will assign a random, unique name. Must be lowercase, to match as it is stored in AWS.

arguments.name: namePrefix
arguments.description: (Optional, Forces new resource) Creates a unique name beginning with the specified prefix. Conflicts with `name`. Must be lowercase, to match as it is stored in AWS.

arguments.name: optionGroupDescription
arguments.description: (Optional) Description of the option group. Defaults to "Managed by Terraform".

arguments.name: skipDestroy
arguments.description: (Optional) Set to true if you do not wish the option group to be deleted at destroy time, and instead just remove the option group from the Terraform state.

arguments.name: tags
arguments.description: (Optional) Map of tags to assign to the resource. If configured with a provider [`defaultTags` configuration block](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#default_tags-configuration-block) present, tags with matching keys will overwrite those defined at the provider-level.

arguments.name: dbSecurityGroupMemberships
arguments.description: (Optional) List of DB Security Groups for which the option is enabled.

arguments.name: port
arguments.description: (Optional) Port number when connecting to the option (e.g., 11211). Leaving out or removing `port` from your configuration does not remove or clear a port from the option in AWS. AWS may assign a default port. Not including `port` in your configuration means that the AWS provider will ignore a previously set value, a value set by AWS, and any port changes.

arguments.name: version
arguments.description: (Optional) Version of the option (e.g., 13.1.0.0). Leaving out or removing `version` from your configuration does not remove or clear a version from the option in AWS. AWS may assign a default version. Not including `version` in your configuration means that the AWS provider will ignore a previously set value, a value set by AWS, and any version changes.

arguments.name: vpcSecurityGroupMemberships
arguments.description: (Optional) List of VPC Security Groups for which the option is enabled.
